definitions.event, strength, matching: line.strike.v3 exactly as tools/eval/measure.ts (detectStrikes + accountStrikes over strikeMotionFrames); an unwanted impact = an unmatched v3 event (onset <= song end).
definitions.cost: (raw/7.55)^2 / beats: its term in the v3 account extraMse
definitions.guide: section (line id block of 10000) with exactly two connected chains in id order: the second chain; equals the production report railGuides on all 679 non-fragment sections of the 4 produced panel rides and 8 Trouble rides
definitions.ceiling line: the line's solid side faces down: normal (dy,-dx)/len for an unflipped line (negated if flipped) has y > 0.5; push direction agrees (down pushes: 1519 of 1524 touch a ceiling line)
definitions.push: largest 2-frame whole-body change in the event (the v2/v3 strength vector: travel x, y, spin); down = y > 0.3 |travel|
definitions.uncounted force maximum: replay of the detector walk: a local maximum of smoothed J >= floor (0.8) whose frame lies in no event's own frames [contactStart, end]; reasons window/rising/spacing/valley; strength = largest 2-frame change over i-2..i+3
definitions.layout: construction request of the section reproduced with planIntentionalRepertoire (planner only); amour resolved-input identity differs from the run (spec file moved, targets identical) and all 4 produced rides are byte-identical to the panel tracks

objective.account: extra cost = (raw/7.55)^2 / beats, same units as a matched beat strength error squared / beats; missing beat = 1/beats
objective.localSearch: arc_evaluate.ts measureObjective: impactWeight 2 x (strength error)^2 + 1 x sum(unmatched strength^2) in [frame-4, next-4) + air^2 + speed^2 + motion residuals; construction fulfilment is a hard rejection

"""Builds docs/research/unwanted-impacts-20261030.json from the scratch outputs.
python3 evidence.py OUT.json"""
import json,collections,os,sys,hashlib,glob,statistics as st,subprocess
S=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); os.chdir(S)
ALL=[json.loads(l) for l in open('events.jsonl')]
E=[x for x in ALL if not x.get('hidden')]
R=json.load(open('events-rides.json')); PL=json.load(open('plans.json'))
M=[json.loads(l) for l in open('missed.jsonl')]; L=[json.loads(l) for l in open('lag.jsonl')]
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
def q(xs,ps=(0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9,0.99)):
    s=sorted(xs); return {str(p):round(s[min(len(s)-1,int(p*len(s)))],4) for p in ps} if s else {}
GROUPS={'panel_authored':lambda e:e['set']!='trouble' and e['pert'] is None,
        'panel_perturbed':lambda e:e['set']!='trouble' and e['pert'] is not None,
        'trouble_7_complete':lambda e:e['set']=='trouble' and e['ride']!='trouble_50s~pulse-101'}
def down(e): return e['push'][1]>0.3*max(1e-9,e['pushTravel'])
def cls(e):
    if e['reversal']: return 'A opposite-push split'
    if down(e) and e['ceiling']:
        return 'B1 roof: body on guide rail' if e['guide'] and e['bodyCeiling'] else 'B2 roof: body on other upper line' if e['bodyCeiling'] else 'B3 roof: sled on a ceiling line'
    if e['kind']=='strike': return 'E renewal within contact'
    return 'C floor re-landing after <=3 f in the air' if e['flightBefore']<=3 else 'D floor touchdown after longer flight'
out={'schema':'line.research-evidence.v1','title':'Unwanted impacts: diagnosis (2026-10-30)','report':'docs/research/unwanted-impacts-20261030.md'}
prov={'analysisCommit':subprocess.run(['git','-C','/home/wyss/line/.claude/worktrees/agent-a0d2427e85c56922c','rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip(),
  'node':subprocess.run(['node','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip(),
  'engineSha256':sha('/home/wyss/line/engine-rs/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/lr_engine.wasm'),
  'inputs':{}}
for set_ in ('dev','confirm'):
    run=json.load(open(f'{set_}/run.json'))
    prov['inputs'][f'v-s2x100-{set_}']={'path':f'/home/wyss/line/.claude/worktrees/agent-a011b559a887ffc0e/generated/eval/v-s2x100-{set_}',
      'runJsonSha256':sha(f'{set_}/run.json'),'compilerHead':run['identity']['head'],'evaluator':run['evaluator'],'mode':run['mode'],'budget':run['budget'],'cases':len(run['panel'])}
prov['inputs']['trouble']={'path':'/home/wyss/line/generated/trouble-variants-v1','collectionSha256':sha('/home/wyss/line/generated/trouble-variants-v1/collection.json'),
  'rides':sorted(r['ride'] for r in R if r['set']=='trouble'),'note':'held-out music: observed examples only; no setting or conclusion is calibrated on it'}
prov['reproduction']={'v3LossRecomputedEqualsSaved':all(abs(r['loss']-r['refLoss'])<1e-12 for r in R),'rides':len(R)}
prov['commands']=['cd <worktree> && LR_ENGINE=wasm node --import tsx <scratch>/ua.ts <scratch>/events.jsonl',
  'LR_ENGINE=wasm node --import tsx <scratch>/missed.ts <scratch>/missed.jsonl',
  'LR_ENGINE=wasm node --import tsx <scratch>/window.ts <scratch>/window.jsonl',
  'LR_ENGINE=wasm node --import tsx <scratch>/lag.ts <scratch>/lag.jsonl',
  'LR_ENGINE=wasm node --import tsx <scratch>/plan.ts <scratch>/plans.json',
  'python3 <scratch>/evidence.py docs/research/unwanted-impacts-20261030.json',
  'frame dumps: LR_ENGINE=wasm node --import tsx <scratch>/dump.ts <dev|confirm|trouble> <case id> <from> <to>',
  '<scratch> holds the panel symlinks dev -> v-s2x100-dev, confirm -> v-s2x100-confirm']
prov['definitions']={
 'event, strength, matching':'line.strike.v3 exactly as tools/eval/measure.ts (detectStrikes + accountStrikes over strikeMotionFrames); an unwanted impact = an unmatched v3 event (onset <= song end).',
 'cost':'(raw/7.55)^2 / beats: its term in the v3 account extraMse',
 'guide':'section (line id block of 10000) with exactly two connected chains in id order: the second chain; equals the production report railGuides on all 679 non-fragment sections of the 4 produced panel rides and 8 Trouble rides',
 'ceiling line':"the line's solid side faces down: normal (dy,-dx)/len for an unflipped line (negated if flipped) has y > 0.5; push direction agrees (down pushes: 1519 of 1524 touch a ceiling line)",
 'push':'largest 2-frame whole-body change in the event (the v2/v3 strength vector: travel x, y, spin); down = y > 0.3 |travel|',
 'uncounted force maximum':'replay of the detector walk: a local maximum of smoothed J >= floor (0.8) whose frame lies in no event\'s own frames [contactStart, end]; reasons window/rising/spacing/valley; strength = largest 2-frame change over i-2..i+3',
 'layout':'construction request of the section reproduced with planIntentionalRepertoire (planner only); amour resolved-input identity differs from the run (spec file moved, targets identical) and all 4 produced rides are byte-identical to the panel tracks'}
out['provenance']=prov
prev={}
for g,f in GROUPS.items():
    es=[e for e in E if f(e)]; un=[e for e in es if e['matched'] is None]; ma=[e for e in es if e['matched'] is not None]
    keys={(e['set'],e['ride']) for e in es}; RR=[r for r in R if (r['set'],r['ride']) in keys]; beats=sum(r['beats'] for r in RR)
    lo=sum(r['loss'] for r in RR)
    tc=sum(e['cost'] for e in un)
    classes={}
    for k in sorted({cls(e) for e in un}):
        s=[e for e in un if cls(e)==k]
        classes[k]={'n':len(s),'nAtLeast0.1':sum(e['strength']>=.1 for e in s),'costShare':round(sum(e['cost'] for e in s)/tc,3),'medianStrength':round(st.median(e['strength'] for e in s),3)}
    prev[g]={'rides':len(RR),'beats':beats,'events':len(es),'unmatched':len(un),'perRide':round(len(un)/len(RR),2),'perBeat':round(len(un)/beats,3),
      'byThreshold':{str(t):{'n':sum(e['strength']>=t for e in un),'perRide':round(sum(e['strength']>=t for e in un)/len(RR),2),'perBeat':round(sum(e['strength']>=t for e in un)/beats,4)} for t in (0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.25,0.3)},
      'unmatchedStrengthQuantiles':q([e['strength'] for e in un]),'matchedStrengthQuantiles':q([e['strength'] for e in ma]),
      'maxUnmatched':round(max(e['strength'] for e in un),3),
      'lossShare':{'extra':round(sum(r['extraMse'] for r in RR)/lo,3),'strength':round(sum(r['strengthMse'] for r in RR)/lo,3),'timing':round(sum(r['timingMse'] for r in RR)/lo,3)},
      'classes':classes,
      'situationsAtLeast0.1':{k:round(v,3) for k,v in {
        'within 12 f after a matched hit >= 0.5':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['sinceMatched'] is not None and e['sinceMatched']<=12 and (e['matchedStrengthBefore'] or 0)>=.5),
        'touches a ceiling line':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['ceiling']),
        'touches a guide rail':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['guide']),
        'body point in contact':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['body']),
        'body only':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['bodyOnly']),
        'rising at contact':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['vBefore'][1]<0),
        'inter-beat gap >= 1 s':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['gapLen']>=40),
        'inter-beat gap < 16 f':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and e['gapLen']<16),
        'contacts a new section (seam)':sum(1 for e in un if e['strength']>=.1 and (len(e['sections'])>1 or (e['sectionBefore']>=0 and e['sections'] and e['sections'][0]!=e['sectionBefore']))),
      }.items()}}
    n10=sum(e['strength']>=.1 for e in un)
    prev[g]['situationsAtLeast0.1']={k:{'n':v,'share':round(v/max(1,n10),3)} for k,v in prev[g]['situationsAtLeast0.1'].items()}
out['prevalence']=prev
# seed vs perturbation
def rate(f,th):
    rides=[r for r in R if r['set']!='trouble' and f(r)]; keys={(r['set'],r['ride']) for r in rides}; beats=sum(r['beats'] for r in rides)
    return {'rides':len(rides),'perBeat':round(sum(1 for e in E if (e['set'],e['ride']) in keys and e['matched'] is None and e['strength']>=th)/beats,4),'meanExtraMse':round(sum(r['extraMse'] for r in rides)/len(rides),5)}
base=lambda r:'~p' not in r['ride'] and (r['ride'].endswith('~101') or r['ride'].endswith('~505'))
out['authoredVsPerturbed']={str(th):{'authored seeds 101/505':rate(base,th),'their perturbations':rate(lambda r:'~p' in r['ride'],th),
  'authored other seeds':rate(lambda r:'~p' not in r['ride'] and not base(r),th)} for th in (0.05,0.1,0.15)}
out['perSongAtLeast0.1']={s:rate(lambda r,s=s:r['ride'].startswith(s),0.1) for s in ('luna_bala_44s','amor_na_praia_46s','tiki_tiki_48s','amour_de_ma_vie_44s')}
# layout
def req(e):

secs=collections.Counter((r['construction'],r['guidance'],r['railLayout']) for reqs in PL.values() for r in reqs)
rows=collections.defaultdict(lambda:{'extras':0,'atLeast0.1':0,'cost':0.0})

tc=sum(v['cost'] for v in rows.values())

  'atLeast0.1PerSection':round(v['atLeast0.1']/secs[k],3),'costShare':round(v['cost']/tc,3)} for k,v in sorted(rows.items(),key=lambda kv:-kv[1]['cost'])]
tr=[x for x in out['byPlannedSection'] if x['railLayout']=='transfer']
out['transferSummary']={'sections':sum(x['sections'] for x in tr),'sectionsAll':sum(secs.values()),'atLeast0.1':sum(x['atLeast0.1'] for x in tr),
  'atLeast0.1All':sum(1 for e in pu if e['strength']>=.1),'costShare':round(sum(x['costShare'] for x in tr),3)}
# guide-required sections
sec=collections.defaultdict(list)
for e in E:
    if e['set']=='trouble': continue
    for s in e['sections']: sec[(e['set'],e['ride'],s)].append(e)
gr={}
for key,reqs in PL.items():
    set_,rid=key.split('~',1)
    for r in reqs:
        if r['guidance']!='required': continue
        lay=r['railLayout']; c=gr.setdefault(lay,collections.Counter()); evs=sec.get((set_,rid,r['section']),[])
        g=[e for e in evs if e['guide']]; gm=any(e['matched'] is not None for e in g); gu=[e for e in g if e['matched'] is None]
        c['sections']+=1; c['guide touched by a matched hit']+=gm; c['guide touched only by unmatched events']+=bool(gu) and not gm
        c['guide touched by both']+=bool(gu) and gm; c['no guide event']+=not g
        mx=max([e['strength'] for e in gu],default=0); c['strongest unmatched guide event >= 0.1']+=mx>=.1; c['strongest unmatched guide event >= 0.2']+=mx>=.2
out['guideRequiredSections']={k:dict(v) for k,v in gr.items()}
# strong asks by delivering section
sx=collections.defaultdict(float)
for e in pu:
    if e['sections']: sx[(e['set'],e['ride'],e['sections'][0])]+=e['strength']**2
by=collections.defaultdict(list)
for e in E:
    if e['set']=='trouble' or e['matched'] is None or (e['requested'] or 0)<.6 or not e['sections']: continue
    r=req(e)

    by[k].append((e['strength']-e['requested'],sx.get((e['set'],e['ride'],e['sections'][0]),0)))

# uncounted

for g,f in GROUPS.items():

    s=[m for m in M if f(m)]; n={'panel_authored':32,'panel_perturbed':16,'trouble_8_rides':8}[g]

      'atLeast0.2':sum(m['strength']>=.2 for m in s if m['reason']==r),'atLeast0.4':sum(m['strength']>=.4 for m in s if m['reason']==r),
      'afterQuietMatchedBeat(<=0.15)':sum((m['ownerRequested'] if m['ownerRequested'] is not None else 1)<=.15 for m in s if m['reason']==r),
      'lagHistogram':dict(sorted(collections.Counter(m['lag'] for m in s if m['reason']==r).items()))} for r in ('rising','window','spacing','valley')}}
out['uncountedForceMaxima']=unc
out['windowCases']=[json.loads(l) for l in open('window.jsonl')]
lag={}
for lab,f in (('quiet (requested <= 0.15)',lambda r:(r['requested'] or 0)<=.15),('strong (requested >= 0.6)',lambda r:(r['requested'] or 0)>=.6)):
    s=[r for r in L if f(r)]; big=[r for r in s if r['change']>=.2]

out['quietCatchForceTiming']=lag

    for k,i in enumerate(s): out[i]=k

    if m['set']=='trouble' or m['reason'] not in ('rising','window'): continue
    # section = the owner event's section, approximated by the plan request containing the frame
    reqs=PL[m['set']+'~'+m['ride']]; r=next((q for q in reqs if q['frame']<=m['frame']<q['next']),None)
    k=(r['construction'],r['guidance'],r['railLayout']) if r else None
    c[k]+=1; cs[k].append(m['strength'])
print('hidden rising/window pushes by planned section of their frame:')
for k,v in c.most_common(): print('  ',k,v,'median',round(sorted(cs[k])[len(cs[k])//2],2))
print('hidden rising: owner beat requested <=0.15 share', round(sum((m['ownerRequested'] if m['ownerRequested'] is not None else 1)<=.15 for m in M if m['set']!='trouble' and m['reason']=='rising')/sum(1 for m in M if m['set']!='trouble' and m['reason']=='rising'),2))
print('hidden rising/window per ride by song:', {s: sum(1 for m in M if m['set']!='trouble' and m['reason'] in ('rising','window') and m['ride'].startswith(s))/12 for s in ('luna','amor_','tiki','amour')})
print('hidden rising/window frames in last 3 s of the song share:', round(sum(1 for m in M if m['set']!='trouble' and m['reason'] in ('rising','window') and m['frame']>R[(m['set'],m['ride'])]['lastFrame']-20-120)/sum(1 for m in M if m['set']!='trouble' and m['reason'] in ('rising','window')),2))
